question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the school name from the department table, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. For each such subject, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material, as well as the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. List the subject title, department name, subject description, school name, window column, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and department phone number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
    AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment,
    STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrollment
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
        AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%'
  )
  GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  b.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column,
  ds.avg_enrollment,
  ds.stddev_enrollment,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds
  ON b.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON b.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_TITLE

dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment,
    STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrollment
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
        AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
    AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment,
    STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrollment
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
   AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM TIP_DETAIL td
      WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
        AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
        AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%'
  )
  GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  b.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column,
  ds.avg_enrollment,
  ds.stddev_enrollment,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds
  ON b.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON b.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
   AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
    AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT,
    STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS ENROLLMENT_STDDEV
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  WHERE t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  )
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  b.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS ROW_NUM,
  ds.AVG_ENROLLMENT,
  ds.ENROLLMENT_STDDEV,
  a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON b.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON b.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
